scientific_integrity: All exact assertions follow from an explicit induction and are checked at finite scales using reproducible integer code; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves all dyadic factor lengths at binomial level two for the ordinary paperfolding word; no non-dyadic or higher-level formula. An unindexed equivalent result is possible; direct finite checks are not infinite proof. The central positional-sum formula uses an explicitly complemented orientation.
title: Exact dyadic 2-binomial complexity of the paperfolding word
